\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{സമയപ്പട്ടിക} (samayappaṭṭika)}{സമയപ്പട്ടിക (samayappaṭṭika)}]{\ml{സമയപ്പട്ടിക} (samayappaṭṭika) — a timetable}

\label{lesson:ML-C180-samayappattika}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to decide, then the Malayalam for to expect.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സമയപ്പട്ടിക}}
\textbf{\ml{സമയപ്പട്ടിക}} — \emph{samayappaṭṭika} — \textquotedblleft{}a timetable\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the board

The board says \textbf{\ml{ബസ്}: \ml{രാവിലെ} \ml{എട്ട്} \ml{മണി}} — \emph{basŭ: rāvile eṭṭŭ maṇi} — \textquotedblleft{}Bus: 8 a.m.\textquotedblright{} The bus leaves at eight, so be there before eight.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{samayappaṭṭika}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{samayappaṭṭika}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to decide, then the Malayalam for to expect, then say \emph{samayappaṭṭika} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അറിയിപ്പ്} (aṟiyippŭ)}{അറിയിപ്പ് (aṟiyippŭ)}]{\ml{അറിയിപ്പ്} (aṟiyippŭ) — a notice, an announcement}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to expect, then the Malayalam for a timetable, then say \emph{aṟiyippŭ} again

\section[(dialogue)]{Saying no and looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R180-first-pass-saying-no-and-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an advertisement and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item nobody, never, nowhere, anyone, anything
  \item recently, already, last, once, to spend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Nobody? (\textbf{\ml{ആരും}}, \emph{āruṁ}.) Never? (\textbf{\ml{ഒരിക്കലും}}, \emph{orikkaluṁ}.) Nowhere? (\textbf{\ml{എവിടെയും}}, \emph{eviṭeyuṁ}.) Anyone? (\textbf{\ml{ആരെങ്കിലും}}, \emph{āreṅkiluṁ}.) Anything? (\textbf{\ml{എന്തെങ്കിലും}}, \emph{enteṅkiluṁ}.) Recently? (\textbf{\ml{അടുത്തിടെ}}, \emph{aṭuttiṭe}.) Already? (\textbf{\ml{ഇതിനകം}}, \emph{itinakaṁ}.) Last? (\textbf{\ml{കഴിഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{kaḻiñña}.) Once? (\textbf{\ml{ഒരിക്കൽ}}, \emph{orikkal}.) To spend? (\textbf{\ml{ചെലവഴിക്കുക}}, \emph{celavaḻikkuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R180-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for next and from now on.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item next, from now on, the future, to decide, to expect
  \item a timetable, a notice, rent, an advertisement, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Next? (\textbf{\ml{അടുത്ത}}, \emph{aṭutta}.) From now on? (\textbf{\ml{ഇനി} \ml{മുതൽ}}, \emph{ini mutal}.) The future? (\textbf{\ml{ഭാവി}}, \emph{bhāvi}.) To decide? (\textbf{\ml{തീരുമാനിക്കുക}}, \emph{tīrumānikkuka}.) To expect? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുക}}, \emph{pratīkṣikkuka}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\ml{സമയപ്പട്ടിക}}, \emph{samayappaṭṭika}.) A notice? (\textbf{\ml{അറിയിപ്പ്}}, \emph{aṟiyippŭ}.) Rent? (\textbf{\ml{വാടക}}, \emph{vāṭaka}.) An advertisement? (\textbf{\ml{പരസ്യം}}, \emph{parasyaṁ}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\ml{രസീത്}}, \emph{rasītŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
